description: Sends one DMX universe of 512 channels to lighting equipment on the local network, over sACN or Art-Net
notes: the module has no jacks of its own; DMX Fixture expanders placed to its right are where CV goes in
the panel reads out the transport, the frame rate, the destination address, the start channel and how many fixtures are attached, with a lamp that is lit while frames are going out
the operating system may ask the first time for permission to let Rack find devices on the local network, and no DMX reaches anything until that is allowed
the DMX side of the plugin is separate from the collaboration side: this Hub talks to lighting hardware and not to other people
menu: Transport: sACN (E1.31), Art-Net — chooses which of the two protocols the universe is sent over
Send Rate — sets the frame rate, 1Hz to 44Hz, and comes up at 30Hz
Universe — sets the universe number, 1 to 63999 for sACN and 0 to 32767 for Art-Net
Start Address — sets the first DMX channel that fixtures count from, 1 to 509, offered as 1 - 64, 65 - 128, 129 - 256, 257 - 509 and Custom...
DMX Host — sets the address frames go to, offered as 239.255.0.1 (multicast), 127.0.0.1 (localhost unicast), 255.255.255.255 (broadcast), 2.255.255.255 (classic Art-Net subnet) and Custom...
